text_block_list.text:
After the checkup, I was cleared for 
discharge, so I hurry and change from the 
hospital gown back into my clothes.

Just lifting her arm sent a sharp pain 
shooting through it, however, making even 
something as simple as changing clothes 
take an unexpectedly long time.

...By the time I finally finished 
changing, more than ten minutes had 
already passed.
(Knock knock knock)

I respond to the knock at the door. It's 
probably the nurse. Opening the door—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...How's your body feeling? Answer with 
something other than 'I'm fine.'

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Understood. In that case... sit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Bring that thing out. You know, your 
usual "textbook."

I open the bag next to me. Then, reaching 
into the inner pocket where I normally 
keep it—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...It was lying on the beach.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: This is yours, right?

Did I drop it the moment I collapsed on 
the beach? Don't tell me someone saw what 
was inside—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I saw it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You've been fooling me, haven't you? For 
all these years.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You've been tricking me this whole time, 
haven't you?! That 'strongest Umamusume' 
crap was all a lie!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Lying with a straight face this entire 
time! Trying to manipulate me into doing 
whatever you want!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't make excuses! Just shut up and 
listen! I already know everything!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Because I figured out... what you were 
thinking!"

Her strained voice trembled ever so 
slightly. From within its resonance, 
something entirely different from anger— 
began quietly spilling over.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How the hell can you push yourself that 
far...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Thinking like an idiot about what to say 
just so I'd actually train properly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Busting your ass just to find the training 
that suits me best! Covering every single 
page in black ink...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even though you decided to deceive me, 
your textbook was covered in apologies 
like "I'm sorry" and "Espo isn't weak"...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why do you push yourself so hard, 
constantly thinking only about me...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why do you always hurt yourself... and 
bottle it all up inside...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...If you care about me that much, don't 
you go forgetting what's most important!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What the hell am I to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What is Espoir City to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...She ain't an Umamusume you don't know. 
And she ain't one you can't rely on, 
either, is she?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Espoir City is your partner, isn't she?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City is the Umamusume you raised! 
She's the partner who's got your back!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm... your Umamusume, dammit...!!

I stand up from the chair and meet her 
gaze.

Back then... she was quite a handful of an 
Umamusume. Time and again, I found myself 
thinking I needed to guide her properly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You still... can't rely on me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You anxious and worried sick 'cause you've 
got no clue what I'm gonna do next?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Right, of course you get it. You know how 
I think.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why you've been givin' me 
instructions all along, right? So I could 
run properly, like myself."

When we first started running together, we 
did nothing but butt heads and miss each 
other's signals.

Yet, getting to know her and walking 
alongside her... I have watched that 
growth firsthand—right by her side.

Her growth, having become so strong and 
powerful.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Forget about that, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't push yourself anymore. Even after 
you're discharged, take good care of your 
body and rest."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Leave things to me for a while!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Trainer-san! Espoir 
City-san!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um, how are you feeling...?
choice_data_list: ...I'll stay still and rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you do that. Keep the talking to 
during training.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You can just sit back and watch after 
that. I'll handle all the prep and cleanup 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't the same girl I used to be. No 
matter how brutal the training is, I can 
handle it on my own."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare underestimate the me you 
worked your ass off to make this strong.
